hyps.why: Edge 4 only carries signal if edge 0 feeds node 1, so a conv there is wasted when edge 0 is none.
Edge 5 is only useful if node 2 gets input, and with edge 1 none it relies solely on the 0->1->2 route.
Edge 2 receives nothing when edge 0 is none, so the conv has no effect.
Edge 2's output cannot reach node 3 when edge 5 is none.
Replacing a 3x3 conv with skip loses much more accuracy than replacing weaker ops.
Removing a conv on the direct edge hurts more than removing a pool or none.
Edge 1 feeds only edge 5 for the output, so the conv is wasted when edge 5 is none.
Replacing a 3x3 conv with a 1x1 conv loses accuracy, whereas replacing pool or none gains.
With fewer competing paths into node 3, a conv on the direct edge adds more.
Capacity at node 3 is already supplied by a direct conv, so another conv adds less.
